Definition: Jeshua, the name of ten Israelites, also of a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Jeshua = "he is saved"; n pr m; 1) son of Nun of the tribe of Ephraim and successor to Moses as the leader of the children of Israel; led the conquest of Canaan; 2) son of Jehozadak and high priest after the restoration; 3) a priest in the time of David who had charge of the 9th course; 4) a Levite in the reign of Hezekiah; 5) head of a Levitical house which returned from captivity in Babylon; 6) father of a builder of the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah; n pr loc; 7) a town in southern Judah reinhabited by the people of Judah after the return from captivity
